title: The Positive Family Support Project - Partnering With Families for a Successful Transition to School
brief_summary: The Positive Family Support Project seeks to understand some of the factors that increase success for children in early elementary school, such as positive family support at home. This study will inform us on ways to help children learn and succeed in school.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: 700 Kindergarten children and their families entering Kindergarten in the Clackamas School District in 2014 and 2015 -
